description: This file defines the ContentExportCommand class, a Drupal console command for exporting content entities in YAML format, with options for dependencies, bundles, and output directory.

classes.name: ContentExportCommand
classes.description: A Drupal console command class for exporting content entities in YAML format, supporting dependencies, bundle filtering, and output directory options.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with a class loader object.
